purpose: Re-extract v13's exact known corpus and open-set rows under three DINOv2 sizes, so that Plan v14 section 7's capacity question is asked with the backbone as the only factor that changes.
registered_question: Plan v14 section 7 and 7.1: does a larger frozen backbone clear the three rejection bars on the identical partition?
registration_notes: N91.1 - all three graphs are the onnx/model_int8.onnx export of onnx-community/dinov2-{size}-ONNX and all three ship a byte-identical preprocessor_config.json at 14e780d8..., which is the hash v13 already registered for dinov2-small. Producer, quantisation scheme, preprocessing, decode path, pooling policy, batch size and execution provider are held fixed; only the backbone changes.

N91.2 - identical rows is a check, not a claim. v13's selection scan is a deterministic prefix walk over hash-locked shards and never consults the backbone, so re-extraction re-derives the selection. The produced manifest must equal the sealed v13 manifest entry for entry on source_file, source_row, image_path, class_label, domain, native_width and native_height. Any mismatch means the reader changed and the artifact is not comparable.

N91.3 - extraction is CPU-only and this was re-measured rather than inherited. v13 measured DirectML disagreeing with the CPU provider by 11.7 percent relative for dinov2-small at batch size one. Repeated for dinov2-base before this config was written it is worse: mean relative divergence 0.2171, maximum 0.2500. The GPU cannot reproduce this backbone's features at any speed.

N91.6 - INT8 damage is measured because it is the obvious confound. A larger model can be quantised worse than a smaller one, and a null result would then be about quantisation rather than capacity. For each backbone the run records the mean relative divergence between the INT8 graph and the same producer's fp32 onnx/model.onnx on a fixed probe set drawn from the corpus. Reported, never gated: it cannot rescue a failing arm, and it exists so that a void verdict under N91.5 has a candidate cause on the record rather than a guess added afterwards.

N91.8 - dinov2-small is re-extracted by this same code path rather than copied from the sealed corpus, so that all three arms are produced identically. Its known-corpus features must hash to v13's sealed features_sha256; a mismatch means this code path is not v13's and no arm is comparable to a sealed number.

extraction.batch_size_rationale: The INT8 graphs contain DynamicQuantizeLinear operators that derive activation scales from the whole input tensor, so above batch size one a feature vector is a function of which other images shared its batch. Batch size one makes each artifact a function of (image, backbone).
extraction.worker_count_rationale: v13's value on this 16-core machine. Worker count cannot influence the values, which is what the shard-invariance control asserts.

quantisation_divergence_control.description: N91.6. Mean and maximum relative L2 divergence between the INT8 graph and the same producer's fp32 graph over a fixed probe set, per backbone. Reported, never gated.
